reasoning_content:
Let me build the remaining: berichtskonfigurator, dokumentenaufbereitung-data-service, dokumentenaufbereitung-monorepo, ner-extraction, request-proxy, tex2pdf-service, tatbestandsmerkmalsextraction, dokumentenschwaerzung-orchestrator, dokumentenschwaerzung-pdf-pii-detector, rechtsquellenvorbereitung.

Many of these use `uv sync --locked` without bind mounts (COPY . /app then uv sync), so the helper should work. Let me batch them. But build times could be long. Let me run in background.

action.command:
cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/batch2.sh <<'SH'
#!/bin/bash
RESULTS=/tmp/batch2_results.txt
: > $RESULTS
for s in berichtskonfigurator dokumentenaufbereitung-data-service dokumentenaufbereitung-monorepo ner-extraction request-proxy tatbestandsmerkmalsextraction tex2pdf-service dokumentenschwaerzung-orchestrator dokumentenschwaerzung-pdf-pii-detector; do
  echo "=== building $s ==="
  timeout 580 /tmp/build_generic.sh "$s" "$s" > /tmp/b2b_$s.log 2>&1
  rc=$?
  if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then echo "$s OK" >> $RESULTS; else echo "$s FAIL rc=$rc" >> $RESULTS; fi
done
cat $RESULTS
SH
chmod +x /tmp/batch2.sh
nohup /tmp/batch2.sh > /tmp/batch2_out.log 2>&1 & echo "started $!"
